$description: Symbiote - a heyrav world. base: any theme; light/dark: per theme; voice: words reworded in this world. Keys are token names without the --.
name: Symbiote
line: Liquid black: slime that reaches for whatever the pointer nears, gloss on every surface, shapes that never sit still.

voice.searchph: Hunt for a component, a token, a pattern
voice.hero.p: Every token, component and pattern behind heyrav.in, wrapped in something that reaches for whatever comes close.
voice.lede.worlds: One body, many hosts. The same components, taken over: type, colour, shape, depth and motion change at a touch.
voice.lede.typography: Bricolage Grotesque, condensed to its narrowest and heaviest, for titles that loom. Archivo carries the reading; Martian Mono keeps the labels cold.
voice.lede.colour: Black that looks wet, bone that looks dry. One gloss for everything that acts, and every text colour clears 4.5:1.
voice.lede.spacing: Tight: a tenth less space than Studio, as if everything were pulled together.
voice.lede.radius: No two corners alike, and none of them stay put.
voice.lede.elevation: Surfaces catch a highlight along the top edge, the way wet things do.
voice.lede.motion: Anticipation, overshoot, snap. Things stretch before they move and wobble after. Reduced motion stills them.
voice.lede.icons: Phosphor Fill: solid shapes, nothing thin enough to tear.
voice.lede.button: Gloss over black. As the pointer nears, the slime reaches for it; pressed, it squashes and springs back.
voice.lede.voice: Terse and physical. Short verbs. Never cute, never cryptic where a label must be plain.
voice.lede.404: Nothing here but the host. Search, or go back to the first page.
voice.type.head: titles
voice.type.head.note: Bricolage Grotesque at 75% width and 800 weight, in capitals.
voice.type.sans.note: Archivo: sturdy and plain, so the reading never fights the gloss.
voice.type.em.note: The same face, hollowed to an outline.
voice.type.label: labels
voice.lede.chip: Pills that squash when the pointer arrives and stretch when pressed. Chosen ones turn to gloss.
voice.lede.badge: Tracked caps; the solid one is the same gloss as a primary button.
voice.lede.card: No two corners alike, and they shift under the pointer while an oily sheen crosses the surface.
voice.lede.input: Wet and dark-edged; with focus the ring breathes in and out.
voice.lede.checkbox: Checked, it pops - overshoots, squashes, settles - and a splash flicks off it.
voice.lede.switch: The thumb is a drop that stretches long as it travels, and snaps back round.
voice.lede.slider: A glossy drop for a thumb that flattens while it is held.
voice.lede.tabs: The chosen tab sits on a thick strand of ink.
voice.lede.accordion: The mark turns with a snap and a little overshoot.
voice.lede.dialog: It opens like something unfolding from its middle, over a dark that drains the colour from behind.
voice.lede.tooltip: Gloss, and a drip hanging from it.
voice.lede.progress: A strand of ink with a bead at its head.
voice.lede.spinner: A blob that cannot hold a shape.
voice.lede.skeleton: A wet sheen sliding across where content will be.
voice.lede.avatar: An organic outline that is never a circle.
voice.lede.link: A heavy underline; under the pointer the word is swallowed by ink.
voice.lede.menu: The item in focus is taken over: ink fills it, the words turn bone.
voice.lede.morph: Bond: slime rises inside the button as the work progresses, the words inverting as it passes them; Bonded, then the host appears.
